jobs.title: Technical Field Representative
jobs.description: Proven experience in troubleshooting, problem-solving, and maintaining complex technical systems Hands-on experience working with mechanical, electrical, electronic, or integrated systems Proven experience working in the field with customers

jobs.title: Information Systems Implementer - Insurance Industry Experience
jobs.description: Previous professional experience within an insurance company combined with a technical background and hands-on experience working with information systems Relevant technological background (technical/scientific degree or previous professional experience in IT) Strong technical capabilities and strong technological orientation (mandatory)

jobs.title: IT Infrastructure Project Manager
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. Academic degree or practical engineer/technician diploma in Communications, Technology, Industrial Engineering & Management, or professional training courses totaling at least 600 hours (mandatory) 5+ years of proven experience as a Technology Project Manager in a large organization (mandatory) Proven experience writing technical specification documents (mandatory)

jobs.title: QA

jobs.title: Data Engineer (.NET / Kafka / ETL)

At least 3 years of experience in backend development using C# and .NET Core (mandatory) Hands-on development experience with Kafka, including Producers and Consumers (mandatory) Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases such as SQL Server (mandatory)
